title: Topology Kernel — Raw Signal
description: Shape of every signal entering the SNR root. Sovereign input contract.

sourceId.description: Who or what emitted this signal. Permanent identity. Used by IME for trust tracking.

field.description: Which of the five fields this signal belongs to.

axis.description: Which polarity axis within the field. e.g. 'connection', 'fear', 'safety'.

value.description: Normalized position on the polarity axis. -1 = full negative pole. +1 = full positive pole. 0 = neutral.

values.description: Optional batch of values for entropy analysis. If present, used instead of single value for entropy gate.

ts.description: Unix millisecond timestamp. Used by causality gate.

sessionId.description: Optional session or pipeline run this signal belongs to.

causedBy.description: Optional event ID that caused this signal to be emitted.

meta.description: Optional passthrough metadata. Not used by SNR. Forwarded unchanged on topology events.
